prompt: Create an original 180 second Chinese chamber instrumental instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: guzheng, xiao, soft wooden percussion. Style: pentatonic melodic arcs, plucked ornament and spacious breath. Tempo approximately 60 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A serene and reflective traditional Asian-inspired instrumental piece featuring plucked strings, a melodic flute, and subtle percussion, building to an emotional and slightly dramatic middle section before returning to a calm close.
description.zh: 一首宁静而富有内省的亚洲风格器乐曲，以拨弦乐器、悠扬的笛声和轻柔的打击乐为主，中段情感渐浓，略带戏剧性，随后回归平静的结尾。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
